script_text: Stop! Pisces, the cosmos is rattling your psychic cage this morning. Venus trines your Sun from the 5th House, so singles attract poetic admirers through creative play, while couples must guard against jealous undercurrents. In career, Saturn retrograde in your 2nd House of money demands you audit overdue bills before a surprise expense hits. Avoid signing any Neptune-fogged contract today; an unexpected blessing arrives via a water-sign sibling's call. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
